messages:
sara (security): Automated scanner just flagged a cross-account snapshot copy where the destination object shows no SSE header. Looks like re-encrypt step skipped. tagging @ben @priya for triage :warning:
ben (eng-ops): which transfer? can you paste the copy id / object path?
sara (security): copy id `cp-7f2b` from `s3://backups-prod/customer-42/snap-2026-03-20-23.tar.gz` -> `s3://arch-external-us-west/tenant-42/`. Object metadata includes `kms_reencrypted=false` and `uploader=uploader-service-v2`.
priya (eng-storage): weird. uploader-service-v2 should call PutObject with SSE-KMS using our destination CMK. if metadata says false, either uploader skipped the SSE header or the copy used a presigned URL.
ben (eng-ops): pulling HEAD now...
ben (eng-ops): HEAD result: ```{
  "Key": "tenant-42/snap-2026-03-20-23.tar.gz",
  "LastModified": "2026-03-20T23:12:40Z",
  "ContentLength": 1073741824,
  "ETag": "\"efgh5678\"",
  "ServerSideEncryption": null,
  "Metadata": {"kms_reencrypted":"false","uploader":"uploader-service-v2"}
}```
arun (eng-infra): uploader-service-v2 had a credentials rotation window yesterday. If a presigned PUT was generated without SSE requirement, the remote account could PUT plaintext. We need to check how presigned URL creation enforces SSE.
backup-bot: Rule encops-23 triggered: cross-account S3 copy without SSE detected. Suggested: suspend replication and revoke uploader principal.
matt (oncall): isolating external bucket and applying bucket-level deny for PutObject from account 9988776655. rotating uploader keys in 60s.
sara (security): please confirm if the object was read after copy (possible exposure).
ben (eng-ops): CloudTrail lookup shows one GetObject at 2026-03-21T00:05:09Z from IP 52.11.22.33 (internal AWS job). That looks like our archive lifecycle job pulled the file.
priya (eng-storage): archive lifecycle should have assumed role `archive-reader@our-org`  if that role read the object, treat it as potentially exposed.
arun (eng-infra): mitigation: 1) suspend all replication to external partners, 2) rotate uploader-service credentials and remove presigned URL capability temporarily, 3) backfill SSE for objects we control by rewriting objects with SSE, 4) request deletion of copies in external account and produce signed proof of deletion.
matt (oncall): applied temporary bucket policy: ```{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[{
    "Effect":"Deny",
    "Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::9988776655:root"},
    "Action":"s3:PutObject",
    "Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::arch-external-us-west/tenant-42/*"
  }]}
```
sara (security): also request CloudTrail export for KMS events: any GenerateDataKey/Decrypt calls around 23:00-01:00Z. If presigned URL used plaintext upload, KMS might not appear.
ben (eng-ops): running KMS event query now. also scanning backups-prod for objects with metadata kms_reencrypted==false. exporting list.
priya (eng-storage): question: do we have an immutable transfer receipt stored for each copy indicating destination CMK used? i recall a proposal to require receipts signed by uploader-service after re-encrypt.
arun (eng-infra): transfer receipts were added to newer uploader variants in March but rollout incomplete. these objects predate full rollout. I'll prioritize enforcing receipt verification server-side and failing copies without it.
sara (security): incident steps: 1) treat external copies as potentially exposed 2) open incident ticket (INC-2026-143) and notify Legal/CISO 3) ask tenant owner whether to notify customers 4) consider rotating tenant keys if exposure confirmed.
matt (oncall): created INC-2026-143, severity P2, tags: encryption, cross-account.
ben (eng-ops): saved affected objects to /tmp/affected-tenant42.txt and attached to incident runbook.
priya (eng-storage): will coordinate with the external partner ops contact (ops-ext@archive-partner.com). legal will own messaging. do not share any keys or PSKs in this channel.
arun (eng-infra): quick remediation tasks: add bucket policy to enforce `s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption` header for all PutObject, update uploader library to reject presigned URL generation without SSE, weekly audit for ServerSideEncryption==null.
sara (security): vuln triage conclusion: operational misconfiguration during credentials rotation + partial transfer-receipt rollout. Severity: high due to cross-account write + subsequent read. Required follow-ups: - enforce SSE via bucket policies and uploader guards - full rollout of signed transfer receipts - weekly SSE scans and alerting - postmortem and update runbook.
matt (oncall): immediate actions done: bucket isolation, uploader key rotation, incident created. I'll post CloudTrail export link when ready. :white_check_mark:
backup-bot: Policy update scheduled: block cross-account PutObject without SSE starting 2026-03-22T00:00:00Z.
sara (security): thanks all. add remediation notes into the incident doc and we'll schedule a postmortem next week. :lock:
priya (eng-storage): I'll draft the external deletion/rewrite plan and share in the incident ticket.
arun (eng-infra): I'll push the uploader library patch to reject presigned uploads without SSE and create a canary job to verify receipts.
matt (oncall): closing operational loop for now; will update when CloudTrail export is in.
